title: Read Discrete Inputs at a high address with quantity one
purpose: Preserve the issue-guided high-address plus quantity-one relationship in a different but recognizable read operation to explore address interpretation and narrow-quantity handling without reproducing historical bytes.
expected_behavior: The target should parse a valid Read Discrete Inputs request for one item at a high address and then either produce normal data or a protocol-level exception according to available mapping.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
Function code 02 request layout is address plus quantity
issue_safety_notes: This keeps only the high-address interaction as a structural analogue. It avoids the historical function/transaction combination and makes no claim about externally verified device semantics.
